_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in. Keep config.json PRIVATE — it holds passcodes and passwords.
_channels_note: Which channels to send alerts on. Any of: email, whatsapp.
_email_note: For Gmail/Google Workspace use an App Password, not your normal password.
_whatsapp_note: provider is 'callmebot' (simplest, sends to your own number) or 'twilio'.
